info.title: Starboard API
info.description: Make a key in Starboard: Settings, Security, API keys. Send it as Authorization: Bearer sb_read_... or sb_manage_... A read key reads; a manage key also does the everyday actions (each POST, marked x-right: manage). x-scope is the scope a key needs. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details. Lists use limit and cursor. Answers carry an ETag; send If-None-Match to get 304.

get.summary: Events as they happen, as Server-Sent Events
get.description: A text/event-stream. Each event is CloudEvents-shaped JSON: specversion, id, type (such as starboard.app.down), source, time and data. A key hears only the events its scopes cover. Send Last-Event-ID to resume. Up to 8 streams at once; each closes after an hour.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: The id of the last event you read.

key.description: A Starboard API key, sb_read_... or sb_manage_...

cursor.name: cursor
cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous answer.

idempotency.name: Idempotency-Key
idempotency.description: Send the same value again to get the first answer back without doing it twice. Kept for 24 hours.

X-Request-Id.description: Yours, or one Starboard made; also in problem.instance.
